svg.title: c2-two-agents-disagree-third-resolves
svg.desc: c2-two-agents-disagree-third-resolves: 10 steps over 3 days from 2026-03-01. Actors: a1 (agent, agent-alpha), a2 (agent, agent-beta), a3 (agent, agent-gamma), h (human). agent-to-agent conflict resolved through compact and submit. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Quorum Replication → $doc. 2. a1 remember Quorum Replication needs three nodes. → $three. 3. [1d] a2 remember Quorum Replication needs five nodes. → $five; expects 1 thing. 4. h lint platform; expects 1 thing. 5. [2d] a3 compact platform → $item; expects 1 thing. 6. a3 submit $item; expects 3 things. 7. a3 submit $item; expects 2 things. 8. h history $three; expects 4 things. 9. a1 search Quorum Replication nodes; expects 2 things. 10. [3d] a3 compact platform; expects 1 thing.

content: # Quorum Replication
Quorum Replication acknowledges a write when a majority of replicas have it. It requires an odd number of nodes.
